Keep the six reviewed exclusions, per-pass fresh exact-endpoint price quote including the 24576-byte planner, cumulative Business exposure, exact-pass admission, Stop and no transport replay. All passes draw from one total ceiling without USD 2 partitions or resets.

leaseHandoffReview.behavior: After reading saved state and validating its plan hash, a POD continuation with a finite future saved controller lease expiry returns waiting/controller_lease_pending with wakeAt equal to that expiry plus one second. This branch precedes plan, claim, cancel and drive operations; a resumed durable step keeps its new random lease token rather than reusing the old process token.
leaseHandoffReview.boundary: No source, recipient, model, data category, price ceiling, pass/call/receipt limit, deadline, migration or owner permission is expanded. Waiting does not authorize transport replay or renew dispatch time.
leaseHandoffReview.verification: Independent current-source static inspection and exact byte-pin verification only. The implementation owner reported a hosted-CI lease handoff defect and is adding regression coverage; this addendum does not claim the new real-server regression, Next sleep/resume fixture or hosted rerun has completed.

limitations: Only full retained excerpts, not full original articles, are reviewed. Each pass remains a bounded collection; even five passes are not exhaustive. Highlights can omit context; retrieval time does not establish publication time.

Domain filters operate before retrieval; returned URL checks are post-return. Upstream search and the search model can process content before application rejection. No guarantee covers all upstream paths or copied restricted material.
Known prohibited uses/sources must remain excluded. Unexpected incompatible or private material must not become trusted evidence; do not bypass a rejection or widen scope.

Generic market interest and supplier claims do not verify Etsy demand, sales, margins, IP clearance, fulfilment promises or commercial viability. Outputs remain hypotheses to test or insufficient evidence.
method: Documented OpenRouter Exa server search, not direct arbitrary page scraping. Each of at most five admitted passes has five model calls and one search use, at most four source results with 1800 characters each, exact-span selection and full-retained-excerpt assessment/review. The whole run is limited to 25 model calls, five searches and 75 exact-receipt metadata checks; receipt checks do not authorize generations. All passes share one total spending ceiling and original finite deadline.

refinementBoundary.analysisBoundary: Each assessment/review still sees all retained excerpts from its current collection. Historical candidate labels and summaries are not promoted into fresh evidence.
refinementBoundary.historyOrigin: SQL derives history from the exact preceding closed insufficient independent review, all earlier queries/source domains and the preceding assessment candidate labels. Caller/owner-supplied replacement history must not be admitted.
refinementBoundary.plannerData: The Azure planner receives the approved public brief and this bounded public-derived review/query/candidate history. Prior reviews remain untrusted summaries; evidence labels are namespaced to the earlier pass and cannot become new source evidence.
refinementBoundary.queryRule: Normalized exact query replay is rejected. Semantic usefulness and genuine refinement remain model/reviewer judgments, not a claim that string inequality proves new research value.
refinementBoundary.sourceProvenance: The distinct historical domain union remains bound in planner admission provenance, including when the next query chooses different domains. It is not new search authorization. Exa receives only the next bounded public query and selected domain filters under the same source policy.

reviewNature: Independent read-only engineering and documented-use review; no owner approval, publisher licence, production activation or paid-run authority.
scope: General print-on-demand product exploration for Etsy under one shared owner-selected total ceiling, at most USD 10. The application chooses queries, relevant public domains and exploratory hypotheses, and may refine an independently insufficient result for at most five passes. No fixed country, audience, theme, product list or final candidate count.
